story-1.text: Sam has a red tent. A cat is in the tent. Sam pats the cat. The cat has a nap.

story-2.text: A frog is on a log. It jumps into a pond. Splash! A duck swims past.

story-3.text: Ben has a gift. It is a red belt. Mum puts it in a bag. Ben is glad.

story-4.text: A fish is in a dish. A cat can sniff the fish. Sam can shut the cat in.

story-5.text: The king has a ring. A bird is on his hand. The bird can sing. The king smiles.

story-6.text: Jess has a badge. The badge is on a bag. Jess takes the bag to the park. It is a big bag.

story-7.text: A quiz is on the desk. Bill picks up a pen. He gets six right. Bill is happy.

story-8.text: Kate has a kite. The kite is red. Kate can run. The kite can rise.

story-9.text: Luke is at home. He has a flute. He plays a tune. Mum likes the tune.

story-10.text: We can go to the park. We see a big tree. A bird is in the tree. We sit and look.

story-11.text: Grace has a bike. She can ride to the gate. She stops at the gate. Then she smiles.

story-12.text: Rain taps on the glass. May has a toy train. She plays with the train. It is a good day.

story-13.text: Lee has a seed. He puts the seed in a pot. He gives it water. A green leaf grows.

story-14.text: Snow is on the road. A toy boat is in a box. Jo puts on a coat. Jo takes the box home.

story-15.text: It is night. A bright light is on. A moth flies by the light. I can see it.

story-16.text: Sue has blue glue. She makes a new card. A star is on the card. The card is for Mum.

story-17.text: Mark has a card. A star is on the card. Mark takes it to the farm. It is for his dad.

story-18.text: A storm comes in the morning. We stay in the house. Then the storm stops. We can go out.

story-19.text: A girl sees a bird. Its wing is hurt. She asks an adult for help. They call a vet.

story-20.text: Two chairs are near a table. A bear sits on one chair. It is a toy bear. A doll sits on the other.

story-21.text: My sister is at the door. She has a pear. My brother has an apple. We share the fruit.

story-22.text: Mum has a book. She sits by the pool. I have a spoon and a bowl. We eat some food.

story-23.text: Roy has a toy coin. He puts it in a box. The box makes a noise. Roy opens the box.

story-24.text: A brown cow is near the house. A mouse runs past. The cow looks down. The mouse hides in the grass.

story-25.text: Paul draws a tall wall. A small cat is on the wall. The cat has a long tail. Paul draws a ball too.

story-26.text: A giant is in the city. He has a gentle voice. A little girl waves. The giant waves back.

story-27.text: Bread is on a plate. A red apple is next to it. Mum has a cup of tea. Breakfast is ready.

story-28.text: Dad has a long rope. He ties a knot. I wrap a gift. We write a card for Grandma.

story-29.text: I have one ball. You have two bats. Come and play with me. We can have some fun.

story-30.text: We pack a basket. A rabbit hops past. We sit on a blanket. The picnic ends at sunset.

story-31.text: A little robot is on the table. It has a purple button. I press the button. The robot plays music.

story-32.text: Anna has a banana. She puts it in her bag. She eats it after a lesson. Then she plays with a friend.

story-33.text: We washed the cups. Dad cleaned the table. Mum played a tune. We wanted to sing along.

story-34.text: I am making a card. My friend is drawing a flower. We are writing a message. It is a helpful thing to do.

story-35.text: My pencil is on the desk. My ruler is in my bag. I open my book. We read a story together.

story-36.text: Our family has a favourite story. It is about a penguin. We read it on holiday. I tell my cousin about the penguin.
